# 1 Clement Chapter 50 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 50 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_050_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 50

**50:1** How blessed and marvelous are the gifts of God, beloved!

**50:2** Life in immortality, brightness in righteousness, truth in confidence, faith in assurance, self-control in holiness — and all these things are within our comprehension.

**50:3** But what are the things prepared for those who wait for him? The Creator and Father of the ages, the All-Holy One, he alone knows their greatness and beauty.

**50:4** Let us therefore strive earnestly to be found among those who wait for him, that we may share in the promised gifts.

**50:5** But how shall this be possible, beloved? If our mind is fixed faithfully on God; if we seek the things that are well-pleasing and acceptable to him; if we accomplish the things that accord with his blameless will; if we walk in the way of truth, throwing off from ourselves all unrighteousness and lawlessness, covetousness, strife, malice and deceit, whispering and slander, God-hating, arrogance and boasting, vainglory and inhospitality.

**50:6** For those who do such things are hateful to God — and not only those who do them, but also those who give their approval to them.

**50:7** For the Scripture says: "But to the sinner God said: Why do you recite my ordinances and take my covenant upon your lips?

**50:8** Yet you hated discipline and cast my words behind your back. When you saw a thief, you joined with him; and with adulterers you cast your lot.

**50:9** Your mouth overflowed with evil, and your tongue wove deceit. You sat and spoke against your brother; you set a stumbling-block before your own mother's son.

**50:10** These things you did and I kept silent; you supposed, O lawless one, that I should be like yourself. I will rebuke you and set the charge before your face.

**50:11** Understand this, you who forget God, lest he tear you like a lion and there be none to rescue.

**50:12** The sacrifice of praise will honor me; and there is the way by which I shall show him the salvation of God."

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
